void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, hero background, primary action fill — the default stage for every screen

carbon-card.$description: Carbon Card — Card and elevated surface background — barely lighter than the canvas so cards read as recessed wells, not raised panels

ghost-white.$description: Ghost White — Primary text, filled button background, primary action fill — the highest-contrast color in the system, used to make actions unmistakable

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Subtle surface washes and light contrast elements — sparingly used for tonal variation in dark sections

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Secondary body text, table content, muted helper copy

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Borders, dividers, icon strokes, disabled text — the workhorse neutral for structural lines

graphite.$description: Graphite — Deep borders, subtle separators between heavy content blocks

lavender-pulse.$description: Lavender Pulse — Violet outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

mint-signal.$description: Mint Signal — Green state accent for badges, validation surfaces, and short status labels.

inter.$description: All functional UI text: body copy, nav links, buttons, badges, table data, card labels. Inter carries the entire system at tight -0.03em tracking — its neutrality lets the single display serif do the editorial work.

alpha-lyrae.$description: Display headlines only — hero h1 and major section titles at exactly 48px. This custom serif is the signature move: a quiet, engraved quality that contrasts with Inter's geometric clarity, giving the dark page a literary anchor.

iowan-old-style.$description: Testimonial pull-quote body — a light-weight old-style serif at 24px that humanizes the interface and breaks Inter's rhythm at key trust-building moments.
